text: つよいのを　つかまえて　こよう！

structure.jp: つかまえて　こよう！
structure.en: I'll go catch and come back!

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.span: つかまえて　こよう
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb with くる means going to do something and then coming back. つかまえて　こよう = 'I'll go and catch some'.

patterns.name: 〜の (one)
patterns.explanation: の after a describing word stands in for a thing already understood, like 'one'. つよいの = 'a strong one'.

patterns.name: 〜よう
patterns.explanation: The よう ending says what the speaker has decided to do, like 'I'll' or 'let's'. こよう = 'I'll come back'.
